record.question: The most liveable location for Asian Expatriates in 2019 rated by ECA international was:
record.explanation: Answer B: Singapore. ECA International’s 2019 survey named Singapore the most liveable city for Asian expatriates for the 14th year in a row. This identifies the survey ranking and date, rather than asserting a timeless liveability ranking. Reference: https://www.edb.gov.sg/en/business-insights/insights/singapore-remains-most-liveable-city-for-asian-expats.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
